{{Quote|When a Gotal gets closer to its intended target, he can sense the animal's electromagnetic aura&hellip;These same sensory abilities have made Gotal some of the most sought after hunters in the galaxy.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Gotals''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of tall, hairy [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] native to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]]. Their most distinctive features were the [[Cones|twin conical horns]] growing on the top of their heads, which acted as highly responsive electromagnetic [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. These head cones were sensitive enough to pick up subtle changes in another being's electromagnetic emissions from emotional changes, making Gotals natural empaths. The unique nature of these sensors shaped Gotal culture, and helped individual Gotals carve niches in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society ranging from [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], the former making a large use of thermite grenades.

Gotals were part of galactic society as far back as the early days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During this time, Gotals served the Republic as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and as [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]]. In the Republic's later years, however, their relations with other cultures became troubled. Conflicts such as the [[Duinuogwuin–Gotal conflict|Duinuogwuin-Gotal conflict]] and the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] resulted in the Gotals taking the losing side in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Distrusted by and distrusting of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Gotals returned to the mainstream as part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and later, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|I've spotted a Gotal.''"''<br />''"''There was a second. They have a scent of old sweat and mildew.''"''<br />''"''And I thought they looked bad.|[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Ylenic It'kla]]|<ref name="EI">{{InsiderCite|66|Elusion Illusion}}.</ref>}}
[[File:GotalNEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A male Gotal]]
Gotals possessed cranial horns as receptors to sense electromagnetism and other energy emissions. These nerve-ending filled cones could sense the natural electromagnetic fields produced by [[Antar/Legends|Antar]], [[Prindaar]], and [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4's]] [[Magnetite/Legends|magnetite]]-rich crust,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> allowing the species to operate even in total darkness.<ref name="GOI 14">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> Their senses also picked up the electromagnetic auras from other life forms. Gotal hunters could sense their quarry from up to ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away, and could track herds of [[quivry]] for weeks.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> While hunting, a Gotal could determine the amount, species type, and level of sickness of animals by relying on their cones alone. When close to their target, they could ascertain information on its mood, awareness, and state of mind. As such, Gotals numbered among the most sought-after hunters in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Gotal cones could detect another being's emotional state and intentions.<ref name="GOI 14" /> Gotal horns were even sensitive enough to pick up such indistinct signals as [[neutrino]] emissions.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Electronic devices could also be sensed by Gotals: in fact, most [[Droid/Legends|droids]] gave off enough electromagnetic emissions to at least annoy a Gotal,<ref name="GOI 14" /> and at worst to seriously disorient the horned beings.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Consequently, the species was notoriously distrustful of droids.<ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook" /><ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref> Gotals relied heavily on their cones, with their eyesight and hearing being quite weak, and their sense of smell almost completely absent.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

At least some Gotals were able to sense [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] with their cones.<ref name="EI" /> Nevertheless, standard reference works such as the ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]'' were silent on the subject,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> and the writings of [[Mammon Hoole]] described this as a rumor which had "yet to be proven."<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> Other sources indicated that both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had conducted inconclusive research which attempted to train Gotals to sense the Force. The records of the Gotals themselves were split on the issue.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> Those sources which did describe Gotals sensing the Force varied in their descriptions. Some sources described it as an intense, overwhelming sensation,<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> while others treated it as a mere "indistinct buzzing."<ref name="Gotal in the Databank">{{DB|species|gotal|Gotal}}</ref> At least one [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], believed that sensing the Force could cause Gotals headaches.<ref name="The Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> Any ability to sense the use of the Force with their cones did not hinder Gotals who were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] in the conventional sense from learning to use the Force, however.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>

Gotals had flat, elongated faces<ref name="GOI 14" /> with reddish, heavy-lidded eyes, small, flat noses, and a wide, downturned mouth full of blunt, yellow<ref name="TOTC">''[[Star Wars: The Original Trilogy Collection]]'', Feltipern Trevagg.</ref> or white [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="ATTR" /> Their eyes varied in color, with individuals sporting shades of [[Color/Legends|red]],<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> orange,<ref name="JCD" /> yellow,<ref name="KOTOR 39" /> gray,<ref name="KOTOR 40" /> green,<ref name="FNU 1" /> and black.<ref name="ATTR" /> Coarse, shaggy fur covered most of their bodies<ref name="GOI 14" /> with the exception of the face, chest, and abdomen.<ref name="SWG" /> Gotals were classified as [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]].<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> Their overall body plan was humanoid, with proportions generally similar to [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Some Gotals had four fingers and a thumb with short, conical claws on each digit;<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> others had only four or three digits per [[Limb/Legends|limb]] with much longer claws making up a large portion of each finger.<ref name="TOTC" /><ref name="SWG" /> Their skin color varied from gray-brown to black,<ref name="Alien Anthology">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> and their fur came in white<ref name="SWG" /> or shades of brown or gray. While male Gotals typically had a thick fringe of hair around their cheeks and chins, this was absent in female Gotals.<ref name="Alien Anthology" /> Gotals shed their fur and most Gotals learned to control this process. Under extreme stress or nerves, however&mdash;as when surprised or frightened<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''.</ref>&mdash;Gotals could lose control of this process and begin shedding large clumps of fur.<ref name="TNR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> Gotals' natural body odor was similar to the smell of mildew and old sweat.<ref name="EI" /> Gotals were resistant to the venom produced by members of the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] species.<ref name="DNII">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>

==Society and culture==
===Head cones in Gotal culture===
{{Quote|Head cones are marvels of the universe. Through their sensory vibrations I can track anyone down. Now I know, and every Gotal knows, that the size of the cones doesn't affect one's prowess, but on Antar IV, where I come from, those cursed with undeveloped cones frequently resort to falsies. (chuckles) It's sad, but true.|[[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]]|audio=HeadCones.flac|<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" />}}
====Physical attraction====
{{Quote|Potion, sir. Love potion for your lady friend? Go from friends to lovers before you can say 'space'.''"<br />"''Why, madam, with cones like these, what do I need with your chemical elixirs?|Female vendor and Feltipern Trevagg|audio=ConesLikeThese.flac|<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" />}}
Horns were the primary physical feature Gotals found attractive in one another. In fact, while smaller cones could be just as energy sensitive as large ones, small-horned Gotals frequently enhanced their appearance with larger false cones. Some Gotals became romantically attached to non-Gotals, but they only seemed to be sexually attracted to other creatures with cones or horns on their heads.<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" />

====Sensory organs====
{{Quote|What's this? There's a strange buzzing in my cones. I haven't felt anything like it since the early days of the Empire when the Jedi were being destroyed.|Feltipern Trevagg on sensing [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]|audio=BuzzingInMyCones.flac|<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" />}}
In addition to sensing energy emissions in their environment and the presence of their prey animals, Gotals used their cones to monitor subtle changes in one another's electromagnetic auras. This ability to quickly and easily judge another Gotal's emotional state was fundamental to their culture.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> For example, Gotals were able to avoid angry members of their species, share in the joy of happy ones, and seek out depressed ones to cheer them up. Gotal communities were considered among the most harmonious civilizations in the galaxy. They had difficulty interpreting the emotions of other [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species, however, often mistaking basic emotions such as affection or anger for extremes such as love and murderous intent. Sufficient exposure to the [[galactic community]] could help them overcome this, however.<ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook" />

Gotals formed intense bonds with one another upon first meeting,<ref name="GOI 14" /> and love at first "sight" was the norm among Gotals, whose empathic nature made the elaborate courtship rituals of other [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] unnecessary.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Gotal would mate for life, and would [[Reproduction/Legends|bear]] young as soon as their lifestyles permitted it.<ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook" /> Gotals only spoke to each other to relay abstract information, since they had no need to vocally express their emotions (ironically, since Gotals spoke in a non-inflected monotone, they seemed emotionless to Humans and other non-Gotals.)<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

[[File:Gotal_Gambler_FC.png|thumb|250px|A Gotal gambler]]
Young Gotals often had trouble assimilating the information arriving from their cones, and were in a constant state of agitated confusion until they learned to filter unwanted signals after about one standard year. Even then, it took them until the age of twelve to attain emotional maturity, and they could sometimes be nearly psychotic until then. Despite this, Gotal parents were devoted to their children, and young Gotals would have children as soon as they could manage it. Mature Gotals were generally calm and peaceful individuals.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

Gotal sensory cones allowed them to keep their emotions to themselves. They tended to keep a calm and restrained demeanor when dealing with others, speaking of emotions only abstractly. This led some non-Gotals to assume the species lacked emotion entirely,<ref name="GOI 14" /> and many species to be uncomfortable around and mistrustful of Gotals. Some felt that they were at a disadvantage when dealing with Gotals and their sensitive head cones, and other, more superstitious species, were wary of what they saw as the Gotals' supernatural powers.<ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook" /> Nevertheless, the quirks of Gotals made them effective [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], mediators,<ref name="GOI 14" /> businesspeople, and [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]]. Unless they sensed evil intentions, Gotals were generally diplomatic and polite when interacting with members of other species.<ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook" />

The ruthless [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial era]] financier [[Sarlim Gastess]] was among the few Gotals whose cones were non-functional. Perhaps because of his inability to sense emotions, this "blind" Gotal was a fearsome psychopath by his people's standards.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>

According to Gotal myth, their head cones could detect evil.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 40">[[Knights of the Old Republic 40|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 40]]</ref>

===Government and society===
{{Quote|The Gotals have developed one of the few societies which exists in peaceful anarchy.|Obo Rin|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />}}
Since their natural empathy made them instantly sensitive to the feelings of others, Gotals had little use for government or laws on their homeworld.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> This resulted in problems when dealing with non-Gotal societies. For example, no central authority figure could speak for Antar 4 as a whole in a crisis, and no organized Gotal military or police force could act on their behalf. The [[Gotal Foreign Affairs Commune]], a group which existed circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], did act as spokespeople for the Gotals during diplomatic crises, but their role in Gotal government is otherwise uncertain.<ref name="Gotal Guerillas Hijack Commuter Hopper, Take Hostages">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|regional/13418_4.html|Gotal Guerillas Hijack Commuter Hopper, Take Hostages}}</ref> Though they had little government of their own, Gotals did send representatives to participate in galactic-level governments,<ref name="Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref> and Gotals living among non-Gotals even worked in local government bureaucracies.<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" /> Other species respected the Gotals for their discretion and restraint, but some individuals feared interacting with the horned beings for fear of having their emotional state revealed to others.<ref name="GOI 14" />

===Language===
The Gotals spoke both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Antarian/Legends|Gotal]], their native tongue. This language lacked vocabulary to express emotional states, and even their version of Basic avoided such terms and context.<ref name="GOI 14" /> Some Gotals spoke Basic with a bleating cadence.<ref name="SOI">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}.</ref> Non-Gotals were incapable of mastering Gotal because so much of the language relied on unspoken cues sensed with head cones.<ref name="GOI 14" /> Gotal naming customs varied. While many Gotals had a first name and a second name, such as Abav Ghart, Kith Kark, Mnor Nha, and Pari Not-goth, others went by single names like Lishma and Tuuve. Other Gotals used names such as To-yel or Mahk'khar, which may have been either single names or a first and second name joined together as one word.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /><ref name="GOI 14" /> At least one Gotal, Toalar Yalom Yalom, was known by a three-part name.<ref name="To Fight Another Day">{{JournalCite|6|To Fight Another Day}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Kith_during_Nadd_Revolt.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Kith Kark, a Gotal Jedi Knight]]
The Gotal species evolved on Antar 4, the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]-rich fourth moon of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Antar/Legends|Antar]] in the [[Prindaar system/Legends|Prindaar system]]. As the moon of a gas giant, Antar 4 was a world with a complex day/night cycle. Sometimes, one side of Antar 4 would be illuminated by the [[Star/Legends|sun]] [[Prindaar]], while the other received almost the same amount of light from the highly reflective surface of the gas giant Antar. At other times, Antar would block all sunlight to both hemispheres. As light was not always available there, Antarian animal life could not rely on sight as a primary sense. To compensate for this, the ancestors of the Gotals evolved cranial horns as receptors to sense electromagnetism and other energy emissions.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

Although they were easily disoriented around devices that produced high levels of electromagnetic interference, the Gotals managed to develop quite sophisticated levels of technology. Using chemical reactions where other species would use electronics, the Gotals managed to colonize four of Antar's other five moons, and set up mining operations on the fifth, even before [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] explorers contacted them.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

The Gotals joined the Galactic Republic between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> becoming one of the first species to send representatives to its newly formed [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Kith Kark]], a Jedi killed during the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]], is the earliest known Gotal to make his mark on galactic history.<ref name="Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]''</ref> [[Goethar Kleej]] and his son [[Aubin Kleej|Aubin]] came to prominence during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] a few decades later as [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]-duelists on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Jervo's World]].<ref name="Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic 39: Dueling Ambitions, Part 1">[[Knights of the Old Republic 39|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 39]]</ref>

In later centuries, one of their most notable contributions to Republic society was the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]], founded in [[620 BBY/Legends|620 BBY]] to assist the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Co-founded by the Human [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Marus Timpel]] and the Gotal businessman [[Kaskutal]], this organization grew to become a major non-Jedi paramilitary auxiliary, working alongside the Jedi Order to protect the Galactic Republic.<ref name="Hero's Guide">''[[Hero's Guide]]''</ref>

In the Republic's final years, however, the relationship between the Gotals and the rest of the galaxy became increasingly strained. The [[Duinuogwuin–Gotal conflict|Duinuogwuin-Gotal conflict]] was a short, but intense struggle which required the intervention of the Jedi Masters [[Jorus C'baoth]] and [[Tra's M'ins]] to bring to an end.<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref><ref name="Dark Force Rising Sourcebook" /> Tensions between the Gotals and the rest of the galaxy continued over the next decade, however.

[[File:Antar_4_Gotals.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gotals on Antar 4 during the Clone Wars]]
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], many Gotals supported the [[Gotal Assembly for Separation/Legends|Gotal Assembly for Separation]] or its more violent splinter group, the [[Roshu Sune/Legends|Roshu Sune]]. After Roshu Sune terrorists set off bombs in Antarian Ranger chapterhouses, the Jedi and their Antarian Ranger allies invaded Antar 4 in retaliation. During the [[Battle of Antar 4 (Separatist Crisis)|Battle of Antar 4]], the Jedi and the Antarian Rangers took heavy casualties. They used [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] weapons in desperation, even though such weapons caused immense pain and disorientation for civilian Gotals caught in the crossfire. The Jedi response turned the Gotals, and the people of thousands of other worlds, against the Republic.<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> After the battle, many Gotal refugees fled to [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]], leading to the [[Gotal hostage standoff]].<ref name="Gotal Guerillas Hijack Commuter Hopper, Take Hostages" /> During this crisis, the Roshu Sune militants captured a [[Passenger liner/Legends|commuter hopper]] that had 25 passengers, one of whom was [[Nathanjo Nirrelz]]. A taskforce of Jedi led by [[Sarrissa Jeng/Legends|Sarrissa Jeng]] attempted to negotiate with the hijackers, but when blasterfire spooked the militants, they executed some of their hostages. The Jedi forced their way into the hopper and killed the Gotal militants. [[Gotal Foreign Affairs Commune]] leader [[Shagrad Loset]] castigated the Jedi for their "lightsaber diplomacy," asserting that the Gotals should have been allowed to solve the crisis themselves.<ref name="HNN Standoff">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|jediwatch/13425_1.html|Gotal Standoff Ends Violently}}.</ref> Although a poll conducted by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] showed that a majority of respondents believed that violence was inevitable in the crisis,<ref name="HNN poll">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53||Quick Poll}}</ref> the events provided the impetus for the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that engulfed the galaxy for the next few years.<ref name="TEA" /> During the Clone Wars, Antar 4 was conquered by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Gotals did not benefit from the war, and were greatly impoverished during the Confederate occupation.<ref name="JCD" /> Around this time, a Gotal team was entered in the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and was represented by the racer [[Arum Oru]].<ref name="CaV">{{LivingForce|Jigsaw: Cloak and Vibroblade}}</ref>

At the war's end, the Gotals became subjects of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Imperial military refused to let Gotals serve in the military, believing they were too apt to empathize with their enemies. Only a minority of Gotals were willing to work with the Empire in any case, since their empathic sense led them to distrust the promises of Imperial diplomats.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />

During the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Gotals were one of the nonhuman races targeted in [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s plot to destabilize the New Republic. The operation was able to brainwash certain individuals to attempt to assassinate major leaders in the New Republic. Three of the targets included [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]], and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], whose intended assassin was [[Tolokai]], her trusted Gotal bodyguard. The intent of the operation was to breed distrust between Humans and prominent nonhuman races of the New Republic. The operation was ultimately foiled.<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had liberated their homeworld, together with the rest of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons" /> At the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Antar 4 became a part of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Gotal senator [[Ta'laam Ranth]] served on the Alliance's [[High Council (Galactic Alliance)|High Council]] as [[Minister of Justice (Galactic Alliance)|Minister of Justice]].<ref name="The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> Circa [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Antar 4's population was between one and ten billion. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Prindaar system/Legends|Antar system]] was attacked by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point during the New Republic's existence, the [[Shi'ido]] [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] Mammon Hoole included an entry on the Gotals in his publication ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

In [[130 ABY]], at least two Gotals were involved with the [[One Sith|new Sith Order]]: an [[Unidentified Gotal Sith|unnamed Sith]] who took part in the [[Massacre at Ossus]],<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 1: Broken, Part 1">[[Legacy (2006) 1|''Legacy'' (2006) 1]]</ref> and the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and information broker [[Attatag Gosem]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> By [[137 ABY]], the Antar system fell within territory controlled by [[Darth Krayt]] as part of his [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]],<ref name="TEA" /> and Gotals were still active in the galactic community.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 35">[[Legacy (2006) 35|''Legacy'' (2006) 35]]</ref>

==Gotals in the galaxy==
{{Quote|&hellip;it is rumored that the finest gamblers in the galaxy learn to bluff by trying to trick Gotal acquaintances.|[[Obo Rin]]|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" />}}
[[File:Glott.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Glott, a Gotal bounty hunter]]
After joining galactic society, Gotals could be found on almost any [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a significant non-Human population,<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> including [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]],<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Centares/Legends|Centares]],<ref name="Triplet Threat">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040122threat|text=Triplet Threat|int=Triplet Threat}}</ref> [[Engebo V]],<ref name="Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20011018a|text=Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter|int=Death, Dirt, and the Nerf Rancher's Daughter}}</ref> [[Horn Station]],<ref name="IaHS">{{Tales|2|Incident at Horn Station}}.</ref> [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]],<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> and [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> They were among the most common space-faring species.<ref name="Alien Encounters" /> A Gotal in a brown robe was present at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] on the day [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] shot and killed the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] bounty hunter [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> A Gotal named [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Kerru]] was another regular patron of Chalmun's cantina.<ref name="SWMB">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles]]''," "Mos Eisley Cantina Adventure Set."</ref>

Gotals tended to avoid the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planets]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] due to the disorienting effects of the many [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and electronic devices on such planets.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> The most sensitive Gotals even avoided the relatively low-level emissions of Antar 4's city centers, preferring to live in remote wilderness areas.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" /> Some of these took up the life of [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], as this work allowed them to spend more time in less developed regions.<ref name="GOI 14" />

Nevertheless, some Gotals made their way to such technological hubs, including planets such as [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]],<ref name="MOD">''[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception]]''</ref> [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]],<ref name="R62">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]].</ref> and Coruscant. For example, a [[Unidentified Gotal speeder bike rider|Gotal speeder bike rider]] nearly collided with the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] when the offworlder ran through a busy street on the planet Coruscant in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="ATTR" /> and in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] another Gotal visited the [[Twirling Twi'lek]] bar on Coruscant bar.<ref name="Jango">[[Star Wars: Jango Fett (one-shot)|''Star Wars: Jango Fett'']].</ref> In 22 BBY, a [[Unidentified Gotal traffic controller|Gotal]] worked as a traffic controller on Atzerri;<ref name="Blood Ties Fett 1">[[Blood Ties 1|''Blood Ties'' 1]]</ref> meanwhile, at least [[Unidentified Gotal (Coruscant immigrant)|one Gotal]] ran into trouble with immigrations officials while trying to disembark on Coruscant that year.<ref name="HNN 51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_1.html|Coruscant Restricts Immigration}}.</ref> Other Gotals were present when the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] scoured the [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]] for [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]].<ref name="EP">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}.</ref> A few years later, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Gotal (Senate Apartment Complex)|Gotal]] was among the evacuees of the [[Senate apartment complex/Legends|Senate Apartment Complex]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> [[Unidentified slum-dwelling Gotal|A Gotal]] lived in the slums of Coruscant in the early stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> Some time after that conflict, some Gotals began wearing [[cone sock]]s to muffle electromagnetic interference in energy-rich environments. Though these were expensive garments at first, they quickly grew in popularity for Gotals traveling in galactic society.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

Their electromagnetic senses often led them to employment as trackers, soldiers, and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Gotal hunters and soldiers were difficult to ambush or trap, and easily saw through most attempts at camouflage.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> They prided themselves on tracking difficult targets, referring to the Gotal proverb "What is easily achieved is easily lost." Some Gotal hunters had developed their empathic skills well enough to accurately and quickly anticipate their enemies' moves&mdash;these were referred to as "precogs".<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons" /> During the Clone Wars, two [[Unidentified Gotal trackers|Gotal trackers]] were employed by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tendir Blue]] to capture [[Ratri Tane]], a defector from the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] who had sensitive information about his former employer. The Gotals tracked Tane to the [[Homestar]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When a pair of Jedi&mdash;[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Ylenic It'kla]]&mdash;showed themselves in the cantina, the Gotals escaped with Tane after a brief [[Mission to Corellia (Clone Wars)|skirmish]]. When the Jedi tracked the Gotals to Blue's headquarters, their captive revealed himself to be another Jedi&mdash;[[Nejaa Halcyon]]&mdash;and overwhelmed their enhanced senses and killed them.<ref name="EI" /> [[Unidentified Gotal bounty hunter/Legends|Another Gotal bounty hunter]] active during the Clone Wars partnered with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] to kidnap the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]] [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway Papanoida]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe Papanoida]] for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. After capturing the targets on Coruscant, the Gotal brought Amanwe to a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on Tatooine. However, his bounty was spoiled by Greedo, who was forced by the captives' [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]], to bring him to the cantina, where he freed them, allowing the family to fight off the Gotal and his partners.<ref name="SOI" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], some Gotal soldiers&mdash;including [[Terrlarn]]<ref name="LOTFM">{{SWMiniCite|set=Legacy of the Force|pack=Gotal Mercenary}}</ref><ref name="Uncivilized">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>&mdash;became [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]];<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> while others joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] or its successor, the [[Alliance of Free Planets]].<ref name="The Truce at Bakura" /> The financier [[Sarlim Gastess]], who headed the Imperial-aligned corporation [[Gastess' Finance, Inc.]],<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9" /> the "precog" bounty hunter [[Glott]],<ref name="River of Chaos 3">[[River of Chaos 3|''River of Chaos'' 3]]</ref> and the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] bureaucrat and part-time bounty hunter [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]] were among the few Gotals who served Imperial interests.<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" /> Another team of Gotal hunters and trappers pursued non-sentient prey along the [[Rryatt Trail]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They set up camp in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] on the planet's surface. The rival hunter, the Rodian [[Tressk]], hired a group of adventurers to kill eighteen members of the Gotal hunting party.<ref name="SWG" />

[[File:BlackMarketGotals-TA.png|thumb|right|250px|Gotals involved in [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|black market dealings]] on Mandalore]]
Some Gotals operated along the galactic fringe as [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrels]],<ref name="GOI 14" /> and criminals. For example, in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], a [[Unidentified Gotal guard|Gotal guard]] protected the entrance to the fortress of [[Alexi Garyn]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] until he was dispatched by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] who was on a mission to assassinate the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigos]] meeting inside.<ref name="DM3">[[Darth Maul (2000) 3|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 3]].</ref> Around that same time, a [[Unidentified Gotal (Uda-Khalid)|Gotal guard]] worked as a sentry outside the [[Uda-Khalid's headquarters|headquarters]] of the murderous dictator [[Uda-Khalid]].<ref name="Surv">{{Tales|13|Survivors (comic story)}}.</ref> [[Unidentified Gotal (Nebula Front)|Another Gotal]] served as a member of the outlaw organization known as the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. He participated in the failed assassination of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Galactic Republic, during a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|trade summit]] on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="COD" /> Another Gotal at this time, [[Nig]], was a member of the [[Raptors (gang)|Raptors]], a gang that operated in the [[Undercity (Taris)|undercity]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In an [[Mission to the Crimson Corridor|skirmish]] with the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darsha Assant]], the Gotal lost his hand and weapon to the Force-user's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="DMSH">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> [[Unidentified Gotal assassin|Another Gotal]] impersonated a Jedi Knight on the moon [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in an attempt to capture the amnesiac Jedi Knight [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]]. When the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Vilmarh Grahrk]] warned Vos that the Gotal was not a Jedi as he claimed, Vos dispatched the imposter.<ref name="R19">[[Star Wars (1998) 19|''Star Wars'' (1998) 19]].</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Gotal [[Noric Gestal]] [[File:Gotal-Vratix.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Gotal and a Vratix]]led a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Noric Gestal's gang|gang]] on the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="TS 10">''[[Twi'light Storm]]''.</ref> During a [[Raid on the Fungus Pit|raid]] at the [[Fungus Pit]] cantina Gestal was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="CSWE I 335">{{CSWECite|I|335|Gestal, Noric}}.</ref> Also during that conflict, a group of Gotal ruffians worked for the [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] smuggler [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]]. They performed heavy labor for their boss, at one point unloading large quantities of a [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] chemical known as [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]] on the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. When [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] investigated the Moogan smuggling, she and her [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|personal guards]] attacked a warehouse where the Gotals were working, killing several in the ensuing [[Skirmish at the Mandalore warehouse|skirmish]].<ref name="Cor">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}.</ref> Other Gotal toughs worked for Mandalore's [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], helping him secretly funnel foodstuffs into the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]; these Gotals were caught on [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] by a group of young [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] at Mandalore's [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy of Government]].<ref name="Acad">{{TCW|The Academy}}.</ref> Others were present at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's palace]] on Tatooine when the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] delivered the plans of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]].<ref name="EP" /> One Gotal fringer worked beyond the bounds of the civilized galaxy during the Clone Wars, reaping the opportunities provided by the war.<ref name="ROTSM">{{SWMiniCite|set=Revenge of the Sith|pack=Gotal Fringer}}</ref> Another such was [[Jauxson]], a Gotal [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who ran a [[Jauxson's pirate gang|pirate gang]] on the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] homeworld of [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] at some point during the Galactic Civil War. Jauxson terrorized several Bith [[City/Legends|cities]] until he was finally [[Skirmish of Buerhoz|stopped]] by a group of offworlders.<ref name="CSWE II 142">{{CSWECite|II|142|Jauxson}}.</ref> Also during that war, the Gotal [[Abav Ghart]] led another pirate gang, the [[Void Demons]], from their [[Void Demon pirate base|base]] on the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Isen IV]] in the [[Isen system/Legends|Isen system]].<ref name="POTG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> Another group of Gotals maintained a [[Gotal Pirates' Base|pirate base]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="SWG" /> The Gotal [[Dakk]] worked as the [[Armor/Legends|armorsmith]] for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Borvo]] in [[Kaadara]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWGED">{{GalaxiesAED}}.</ref> Gotals were among the crew of the pirate leader [[Drek Drednar]].<ref name="SAD">{{JournalCite|5|Stand and Deliver}}</ref> One [[Unidentified Gotal smuggler|Gotal smuggler]] was captured by the Empire. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] then used the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]] to burn his mind, transforming him into a feral beast, driven by fear, and used him as a fanatical guard. Many years later, in 12 ABY, Han Solo and Chewbacca encountered the Gotal on Belsavis in the underground catacombs.<ref name="Children">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> During the reign of the New Republic some years later, [[Mahk'khar]], a Gotal bounty hunter, rose to become a prominent crimelord of the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. Mahk'khar obtained a powerful dark side [[Kashi Mer talisman|relic]], which he traded to the dark Jedi [[Durrei]] on the abandoned planet [[Jandoon]].<ref name="Relic article">{{JournalCite|6|Relic (article)}}</ref> Later, a [[Unidentified Gotal guard (Atzerri)|Gotal]] worked on Atzerri as a guard for [[Joreb Goss]], a drug addict.<ref name="Shield of Lies" />

Other Gotals found legitimate work. During the [[Death Seed]] crisis of [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], a [[Unidentified Gotal captain|female Gotal]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] the [[Quarantine Enforcement Cruiser]] ''[[Lycoming]]'', which belonged to the [[Coruscant Institute]]. She was accompanied by a [[Tuuve|Gotal]] [[Chief medical officer]]. Upon responding to a distress call from the ''[[Empyrean]]'', the Captain discovered a group of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] scavengers led by [[Ugmush]], and subsequently arrested them. She later arrested the investigative journalist [[Yarbolk Yemm]] and ordered him thrown out an airlock to protect the [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]], which was behind the Death Seed outbreak.<ref name="Planet of Twilight" />

Thanks to their empathic abilities, they also worked as [[Noble/Legends|nobles]],<ref name="GOI 14" /> diplomats, counselors, and even professional gamblers. This sort of employment gave rise to the erroneous belief that Gotals were [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]], a misconception which made some people uncomfortable and suspicious when dealing with Gotals. In fact, the opposite was often true&mdash;Gotals with little experience dealing with non-Gotals frequently misunderstood their emotional states, mistaking moderate anger for imminent violent intent, and mild affection for love.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> Many Gotals joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]; as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], their natural empathic abilities supplemented their ability to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="GOI 14" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gotal alien design was created for [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]{{'s}} [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] scene by conceptual artist [[Ron Cobb]].<ref name="CRC">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> Either Cobb or makeup artist [[Laine Liska]] sculpted the Gotal masks and hands used in the film.<ref>''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]'' claims that Cobb sculpted the masks. However, {{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}, p. 3, suggests that Liska did so.</ref> Cobb's concept illustrations feature biological notes, describing the species as a "High Tundra" creature. High Tundra became the characters' on-set nickname.<ref name="CRC" />

Although the proper name for one of the characters was initially Dratun, later [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] sources beginning with [[Troy Denning]]'s [[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'' (First Edition)]] identified the species name as Gotal, and one of the characters seen in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] as [[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]].<ref name="CRC" />

The various ''Star Wars'' roleplaying games have presented Gotals as a species players may choose to portray in their games. ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' from [[West End Games]] was the first game to describe the Gotals. In addition to the sensory abilities from the head cones, West End Games sourcebooks presented the Gotals as slightly stronger and potentially more perceptive and dexterous than human characters, but generally less adept with technological and knowledge-based skills.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4" /> The [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|Saga Edition]] of the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' from [[Wizards of the Coast]] presents them as equivalent to most species in most respects but allows them to sense the emotional state of those within six meters. The game allows these targets to resist the Gotal's prying, however. The game also indicates that Gotal characters can, in fact, sense the Force with their cones.<ref name="GOI 14" />
